name: Streamkap
description:
Streamkap is the developer platform for real-time data. It uses change data capture (CDC) to stream changes from your databases to apps, warehouses, and AI agents the moment they happen.

This connector wraps the Streamkap API as MCP tools so you can operate your data infrastructure in natural language - no dashboard required. Connect operational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Oracle, SQL Server, DynamoDB, and more) to warehouses, lakes, and analytics destinations (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, ClickHouse, Redshift, and more), with managed Kafka and Flink plus SQL, Python, and JS transforms in between.

Ask Claude to:
- Check pipeline health - "Which pipelines are failing, and what are their latest errors?"
- Build a pipeline - "Connect my Postgres orders table to Snowflake with incremental updates."
- Diagnose latency - "End-to-end lag on prod-events jumped this morning. What changed?"
- Triage dead-letter queues - "Find every DLQ with messages in the last hour, group by error class, and suggest fixes."
- Inspect data and schemas - "Read 10 recent messages from a topic and decode them with the registry."

_published_faq.name: How do I add Streamkap to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Streamkap to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.streamkap.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Streamkap MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Streamkap lists 45 MCP tools, including streamkap_consume_messages, streamkap_create_destination, streamkap_create_pipeline, streamkap_create_source, streamkap_deploy_destination, streamkap_deploy_source, streamkap_describe_tool, streamkap_diagnose_pipeline, streamkap_execute_snapshot, streamkap_get_alerts_summary, streamkap_get_caller_identity, and streamkap_get_dashboard_health.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Streamkap?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Streamkap in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Streamkap requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Streamkap is developed by Streamkap Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
